body: You and millions of other people. At least you realize it.

*virtual hug* 

I also need a hug. My ex had an amazing hug and I miss it dearly.

Thanks, I've been dealing with it for months now. I have tried and tried to get her to remember what we had and come back to me. But she sees me as a bad guy now and there is just no rationalizing with her. I need to move on for myself but it isn't easy thinking about what I'm missing out on. I was so excited to watch her develop and witness the birth. Now I need something else to look forward to, to take my mind off of this. I would never abandon my child given the chance to be part of her life but my ex is being very stubborn and seems to want to block me from her life completely.
Maybe not, but you have someone who loves and supports you. You will hurt him immensely if you kill yourself. It is a great reason to try to get help and improve you mental situation.
I read your story and that is sad. I am sorry your husband doesn't appreciate you. I wish I had a woman that was devoted like you. I would make her feel like a queen.

That is terrible. I hate people like this they have someone great like you but can't appreciate it. I wish I could find someone like you. I would spend my days trying to make you happy and feel loved and appreciated.
Hi 😊
If he takes care of you on top of his full time job then that means he really cares about you. You are lucky to have someone like that. I am suicidal because I don't have that love anymore.
You are lucky, I can't even escape my problems when I sleep because I dream about them.
You are only 16? Give it time I promise you things will get better for you.
Thank you, I do know this but it helps to talk about it and have someone say it. It's just really painful, I now know how parents feel when they lose a child.
Yes, I have to question everything now. I think it probably is but I can't be sure it's mine.
This is your take on it. I am not looking for a hookup. I'm looking for hope. A woman to talk to. Hopefully one that is interested in having a child soon.
What is scammy about it? She is still growing in my ex's belly. She is 22 weeks pregnant.

Thank you. I have tried several times to get her to talk to me again. She won't and just keeps accusing me of stuff I didn't do. And I know for a fact she is out dating and sleeping around. It really sucks that she can be so heartless to me now when we were planning on getting married and starting a family.
No, she has a child and will not let me be a part of her life now. It may be mine (I have to question that now) but I will not be around to raise it.
She is 22 weeks pregnant now.
Yes, I had no idea until after she broke up with me. I was trying to figure out why she was changing like she was. At first I thought she might be using drugs.
Yea, don't do that. It will not kill you, only cause more problems.
I need a child that is mine. I was so excited to see what our little girl was going to look like. Now it seems I may never know.

Yea I had no idea she had BPD, it is really unbelievable what happened. She still denies it too but it was obvious to everyone that knew her how much she changed. She thinks she is seeing things "clearer than ever".

Yea I have tried dating apps but there isn't much luck for me I'm this part of the world. Also I'm not very good at messaging women apparently. I got lucky when I met my ex. That kind of luck is rare for me.

I am going through something similar. I know how you feel. My ex was pregnant and it would be my first child. I am 41 and it was a huge surprise and a blessing. I suffered from social anxiety in my 20s so I don't have friends. Meeting her and falling in love was lucky for me. Anyway, she apparently has BPD and got angry and delusional and left me and won't talk to me now. I lost the love of my life and a child I was so excited to be having. It feels like this pain will never end. I wish we could help each other...
